historical_reviews.v3_1: Remote power mutation remains owner-approved and attended even when the command itself is automatable.

original_test_intent: Power on the intended SUT from a verified off state through the BMC Web UI, then prove a clean chassis, POST and OS transition with no new platform error.
original_method: Verify target and off state, preserve a complete baseline, issue one approved Web UI power-on or documented equivalent API action, monitor actual chassis/POST/OS readiness and compare device, storage, health and event evidence.
manual_activity: The owner confirms the target, off-state semantics, maintenance window and desired final state; an operator supervises the one-time power-on and console/POST/boot recovery.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/BMC identity and verified off/standby definition
Owner approval and expected final workload state
Supported BMC Web UI action or documented equivalent API
Clean workload/storage and no active firmware operation
POST/OS readiness signals, timeout and event acceptance rule
safety_requirements: Require explicit approval before changing power state
Reject ambiguous target or stale chassis status
Do not act during writes or firmware activity
Keep credentials out of command arguments and logs
Use real readiness rather than fixed sleep
Monitor console, POST, OS, storage, devices and thermal/power health
Stop on timeout, wrong target or anomaly and do not auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, off state, approval and clean preconditions
Invoke one approved protected power-on interface
Poll authoritative chassis, BMC, POST and OS readiness
Compare post-on devices, storage, health and logs without retry, recovery autonomy or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve target, transition and final state
Supervise the power and boot transition

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The power-on concept is relevant, but plaintext password arguments, fixed sleep and chassis status alone are unsafe and incomplete.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the owner-approved Web UI or protected documented API once, then wait on real POST/OS and health signals.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC Web UI power-on intent, no-error criteria, private scripts and 1/15-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform a target-off-baseline-single-poweron-readiness-health sequence with protected credentials and bounded monitoring.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds API-equivalence documentation, secret safety, real boot readiness and complete event/device comparison.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A chassis-on bit after five seconds does not prove POST, OS, devices, storage or no new errors.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong-target control or an unhealthy boot can disrupt service and require supervised recovery.

project_override_considerations: The project may use Web UI, Redfish, IPMI or another validated interface only if its semantics are documented as equivalent; it must preserve one transition, secure credentials, real readiness and full event/health evidence.
expected_evidence: Approval, target identity, true off state and clean workload/storage state
Immutable pre-on chassis, device, storage, health and event baseline
Redacted Web UI/API audit and one power transition
BMC, console, POST and OS readiness timeline
Recovery actions if any and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure, Criteria and scripts consistently describe BMC-controlled power on; the incomplete DeepSeek command does not create a source conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Target, approval, interface and readiness rules are supplyable normal execution inputs, so the case is conditionally executable rather than permanently blocked.

review_improvement: Replaces fixed-delay chassis-status evidence with a protected one-time power transition and full boot, device, storage and event-health proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: The mutation can be scripted, but safe execution depends on owner approval, correct off-state identity and supervised boot recovery. A successful power command is only transport evidence; the acceptance criteria require an end-to-end platform oracle.
